name: tshopper — catalogue and shop as a capability of their own
summary: Phase A: draw the boundary between the service catalogue/shop and the engine inside the single binary, and give product managers, line managers and customer responsibles delivery-SLA, consumption and order reporting.
next_action: Paused after phase A by the owner's decision (2026-10-31). To restart: move the 37 server files that import api/catalog or api/order behind api/shopcontract (TestServerFilesReachingIntoTheShopOnlyBecomeFewer tracks the count), settle ADR-0515's open question on public holidays, and decide phase B (separate binary) in its own ADR before any work on it.
